news.title: Frequent cannabis use tied to more severe epilepsy
news.summary_en: A study led by WashU Medicine researchers found that near-daily cannabis users with drug-resistant epilepsy had over twice as many convulsive seizures as nonusers, and they became resistant to antiseizure medications faster.

news.title: A unique solution for bioelectronics: collagen and cacao butter
news.summary_en: Biomedical engineers at WashU McKelvey Engineering developed an additive manufacturing method using a 3D printer that builds bioelectronic materials from collagen and a polymer that can carry electrical signals, work that could ultimately improve the function of medical implants.

news.title: Cancer survivors less likely to be physically active, study finds
news.summary_en: Adults with a history of cancer are less likely to be physically active than those without a cancer history, finds a new study from Washington University in St. Louis.
